seo.title: About IGCH · Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital, Kochi
seo.description: Fifty years of caring for Kochi, together. The story, leadership, team and achievements of Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital, Kadavanthra.

hero.lead: Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital is owned by the community it serves — a hospital built on co-operation, now bringing advanced specialist care to Kadavanthra and beyond.

items.caption: years serving Kochi as a co-operative
emergency, ICU, OT and blood bank

head.heading: A hospital the community built for itself.

paragraphs: IGCH began as a co-operative effort: citizens of Kochi pooling together so that good medical care would be within everyone's reach. Five decades on, that idea still shapes how we work.
